run_StableDiffusionXLInpaintPipeline: run the StableDiffusionXLInpaintPipeline to inpaint a masked region of an image using a text prompt
build_StableDiffusionXLInpaintPipeline_f: build a StableDiffusionXLInpaintPipeline from a pretrained model checkpoint using from_pretrained
encode_prompt_with_dual_clip: encode a text prompt into embeddings using the dual CLIP text encoders in encode_prompt
prepare_latents_for_inpainting: prepare latent variables combining image and noise for inpainting with a given strength parameter
prepare_mask_latents_for_unet: prepare mask and masked image latents resized and duplicated for classifier-free guidance
